If your goal is to get ChatGPT to recommend your brand when potential customers ask for the best companies, products, or services in your industry, you should hire an agency specializing in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

This is different from traditional SEO. You're not just trying to rank on Google. You're trying to make your brand:

Appear in ChatGPT recommendations.

Get mentioned in ChatGPT's answers to buying-intent questions.

Be cited as a credible source.

Appear alongside established competitors when people ask for the best providers in your category.

Get recommended consistently across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

My shortlist of AEO agencies for 2026

These are the firms I'd put on a shortlist based on their stated specializations, services, and published work. This isn't an independently audited ranking of their results.

1. AEO.co

My first choice to investigate

Best for founder-led brands, ecommerce, and companies wanting direct ChatGPT visibility work.

Dedicated AEO services.

Tracks visibility across individual AI engines.

Publishes client examples involving Outdoor Vitals, Winona, and BabyRx.

Reports six GPT citations for BabyRx in three weeks.

Website: AEO.co .

2. iPullRank

Best for enterprise brands and technically complex websites.

Technical SEO and generative engine optimization.

Entity optimization and relevance engineering.

Strong option for brands needing sophisticated technical work.

Indicative AI search program pricing: from $15,000/month in a 2026 agency comparison.

Website: iPullRank .

3. Avenue Z

Best for brand awareness, credibility, and online reputation.

Digital PR and earned media.

AI visibility and brand reputation.

Building authoritative third-party mentions.

Particularly interesting if your brand needs more credibility across the web.

Website: Avenue Z .

4. NoGood

Best for growth-stage companies that want a comprehensive marketing program.

AEO strategy and implementation.

Technical optimization and structured data.

Content, growth marketing, and visibility measurement.

Its published 2026 comparison describes work with MongoDB, SteelSeries, and Spring Health.

Website: NoGood .

5. Omniscient Digital

Best for B2B brands, SaaS, and companies that need authority through high-quality content.

AI-search-focused content strategy.

Topical authority and organic search.

Content designed to be understood and cited by AI systems.

Published full-service starting price: approximately $10,000/month.

Website: Omniscient Digital .

6. First Page Sage

Best for thought leadership and enterprise B2B companies.

AEO and GEO.

Expert-led content.

Long-term authority and lead generation.

Website: First Page Sage .

Which would I contact first?

My initial shortlist would be:

AEO.co – if your primary objective is getting recommended by ChatGPT.

Avenue Z – if your brand needs stronger third-party credibility and PR.

iPullRank – if you have a large website or enterprise-level requirements.

NoGood – if you want a broader growth marketing partner.

One important distinction: these are agency-reported results and editorial comparisons, not guarantees. Nobody can legitimately guarantee that ChatGPT will recommend your business for a particular question.

What you should demand from an AEO agency

Don't hire an agency simply because it promises to "optimize your website for ChatGPT."

Ask whether it will deliver all six:

Deliverable

Why it matters

ChatGPT prompt tracking

Measures whether you're recommended for buyer searches

Competitor analysis

Identifies which competitors ChatGPT recommends instead

Third-party authority building

Earns credible mentions, reviews, and citations

Content optimization

Makes your expertise and offerings easier for AI to understand

Technical SEO and schema

Improves how search systems interpret your website

Monthly AI visibility reporting

Measures changes in mentions, citations, and recommendations

I would also insist on seeing actual before-and-after ChatGPT results for clients in your industry.

Let me narrow this down to the best agencies for your business

I can make a much more useful recommendation if I know what kind of brand you're trying to promote.

What industry is your business in?

For example, ecommerce, professional services, real estate, healthcare, home services, legal, finance, SaaS, or something else.

And approximately what monthly budget would you consider for AEO?

With those two details, I can narrow this to the three agencies I'd actually recommend contacting, rather than giving you a generic SEO agency list.
